annotations.text:
Tax Source India — homepage v2
New since v1: visual-led hero built around your photo, an industries strip, photography through the Why-us section, an 8-question FAQ, and a map band under contact.

Remaining dashed boxes are photo slots with purpose and pixel size on them; every [SQUARE BRACKET] is a real fact still to fill in.
Mobile v2 — same sections condensed. Tap targets 44px+. The call bar sits at the end of the page here; in build it should be pinned to the bottom of the viewport.
v1 — the original pass, kept for comparison. No photography; text and vector icons only.

Design system extracted from the homepage — colour, type, spacing, elevation and the component set.
Every value is lifted from the built artboards rather than rounded to a grid, so anything new built from this sheet will match the page exactly.
